generated.description: A large multi-storey Victorian-style mansion built mainly from red brick, stone brick, spruce and quartz, with white wool accents, glass panes and a grass-block lawn base. It measures about 39 blocks wide, 63 high and 69 deep, roughly 26,700 blocks in total. The interior holds chests, furnaces, hoppers, signs, a record player and music blocks, plus some redstone comparators and trapped chests.
